title: 示例素材 · 科研交流短句
description: 4 句原创表达，练习提出研究问题、解释贡献与回答追问。请按真实项目替换内容。

sentences.en: Let me start with the main question of our study.
sentences.zh: 我先介绍一下我们研究的核心问题。
sentences.note: Let me start with 引出报告的第一部分。
sentences.question: What is the main question of your research?

chunks.en: the main question of our study

sentences.en: My main contribution was developing a reproducible analysis workflow.
sentences.zh: 我的主要贡献是开发了一套可复现的分析流程。
sentences.note: was developing 用动名词说明具体贡献；仅在符合本人经历时使用。
sentences.question: Which part of the project did you lead?

chunks.zh: 开发可复现的分析流程

sentences.en: Could you clarify which part you would like me to explain?
sentences.zh: 您能明确一下希望我解释哪一部分吗？
sentences.note: Could you clarify 是礼貌确认问题的常用表达。
sentences.question: How would you ask for clarification during an interview?

chunks.en: which part you would like me to explain
chunks.zh: 您希望我解释哪一部分

sentences.en: We would need additional evidence to support that interpretation.
sentences.zh: 我们还需要额外证据来支持这一解释。
sentences.note: would need 表达有条件的判断，不把解释直接当作已证实结论。
sentences.question: What evidence would strengthen your interpretation?
